Name: Ecolibrium
Description:
Ecolibrium is a sustainability tech company that empowers people to make better decisions based on proven data-driven ML algorithms through continuous monitoring, analysis and seamlessly integrated automated recommendation engines.

We accelerate organisations’ decarbonisation journey through real-time actionable insights on a single pane view, driving measurable actions to meet their Net-Zero goals while elevating productivity and reducing operational costs across their entire portfolio. It’s a finely tuned balance between people, planet and profit.

At Ecolibrium, we are dedicated to our partners-first approach. We walk hand-in-hand with our clients, ensuring a collaborative effort that drives sustainable, continuous improvement. We are more than just a technology provider; we are your dedicated partner in achieving common goals for a greener, more efficient organisation.

Ecolibrium is ISO 27001 certified and adheres to the ISMS framework of standards. We have won several awards over the last decade, including the prestigious WWF Climate Solver Award, the UNFCC award and the Ashden International Award.

Name: Sylvera
Description:
Sylvera is the independent carbon data platform trusted by buy and sell side market participants and policymakers to navigate the carbon market with confidence. 

We build data models and software tools that combine extensive project assessments, real-world market and pricing intelligence, and geospatial lidar monitoring to deliver actionable insights that drive real climate action.

Sylvera enables smarter, faster, and more confident decisions by combining quality indicator, price, and real-world performance data into a single source of truth.

We're backed by renowned investors like Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Insight Partners, LocalGlobe, and Salesforce Ventures.

Name: Terrascope
Description:
Terrascope is The Easiest Platform to Measure and Decarbonize Land, Nature, and the Net-Zero Economy (IDC Leader 2025)

Built for enterprises navigating complex sustainability challenges across corporate operations, products, and supply chains, Terrascope transforms carbon management from a compliance burden into a strategic advantage. 

Companies in food, agriculture, and manufacturing achieve results in weeks that previously took quarters. Public case studies prove it: 5x faster measurement cycles, 92% accuracy in filling supplier data gaps, and 100% approval rate for SBTi FLAG target submissions.

Global leaders including Kellanova, Mitsubishi Shokuhin, Dole, Vitasoy, Sigma Alimentos, and Olam Agri rely on Terrascope because it makes the hardest parts of decarbonization actually manageable. 

Recognized by Verdantix 4 times, the platform combines AI-powered automation with deep expertise in land-intensive sectors where Scope 3 emissions drive 80-90% of total footprints.

Why "easiest" matters:
Generic carbon platforms fail to deliver the transparency and granularity required for sectors with complex value chains. Agricultural emissions, land use change, biogenic carbon flows, and fragmented supplier data create measurement nightmares. Terrascope was purpose-built to solve these challenges through AI-assisted data processing, proprietary agri-food emission factor libraries, and over 10 years of ground truth from measuring 500+ million tonnes of emissions across food and agricultural supply chains.

-- Business impact, not just compliance --
Time to value: Shorten measurement cycles by up to 80% vs. traditional approaches. Teams focus on reduction, not data wrangling.

Audit-ready precision: 92% accuracy in estimating supplier emissions when primary data is unavailable, maintaining full transparency and traceability.

ROI-driven action: Scenario modeling ties every decarbonization initiative to financial impact

Name: Unravel Carbon
Description:
Unravel Carbon is the world’s first agentic platform for sustainability outcomes. Our AI agents and award-winning sustainability management platform set us apart. 

Our solutions are used by leading global companies and consultants in more than 50 countries to simplify emissions tracking, meet global regulatory standards, and accelerate climate action.

Our calculation methodology is certified by TÜV Rheinland against the GHG Protocol corporate standard for Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions, and the ISO 14064 series for GHG inventories.

We ensure data security with our ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type 1 attestation.

At Unravel Carbon, we are driven by a powerful mission: to accelerate the world's progress toward a zero-carbon economy. 

Unravel Carbon is backed by top-tier investors including Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, and has offices in the U.S., Japan, Australia and Singapore. For more information please visit unravelcarbon.com.

Name: ASUENE Inc.
Description:
ASUENE is a leading AI Sustainability Integrated Platform, trusted by 64,000+ companies worldwide and backed by over US$160M in funding from investors including Decarbonization Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and SMBC.

Our flagship platform, ASUENE, supports GHG measurement, reduction, and reporting across Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions. ASUENE LCA enables product-level lifecycle assessment and carbon footprint (PCF) calculation, while ASUENE SUPPLY CHAIN helps enterprises engage suppliers and manage emissions data across complex, multi-tier supply chains.

Beyond our core platform, we offer a growing suite of specialized AI solutions: NZero, an AI Energy Optimization Platform; Carbon EX, an Integrated Carbon Credit AI Platform; Secaro, a Supply Chain Intelligence Network; and Iconic Air, an AI-powered Methane Emissions Management platform.

Through our AI-powered platforms and expert consulting — including third-party assurance and disclosure advisory via ASUENE VERITAS — we help companies of every size advance sustainability management, meet evolving regulatory requirements such as CSRD and CDP, and accelerate their transition toward net zero.

Description: Gprnt's (pronounced ‘Greenprint’) mission is to empower SMEs, financial institutions, corporates and governments to seamlessly collect, report and act on sustainability data.

Name: AIRINS
Description:
AIRINS develops proprietary methane sensing hardware, deployment integrations, field software and Source-Resolved Quantification (SRQ) as one connected technology stack.
We help operators screen pipelines, facilities and landfills, localize likely methane sources, verify findings at close proximity, and quantify source- and site-level emission rates. MetScan, AIRINS.ai and SRQ connect deployment, measurement, visualization and reporting in one field workflow.
Our wider portfolio includes Sniffer4D gas mapping, Speedip UAV water sampling and the AIRINS Meteorological System.
Conceived in Auckland, New Zealand. Headquartered in Singapore. Engineered across Shenzhen and Singapore. Built for methane operations worldwide.
Formerly Soarability. Explore AIRINS at www.airins.com.

Name: Evercomm
Description:
Evercomm is a multiple award-winning company with carbon reduction engineering solutions to help transition the industrial world towards a lower-carbon future. Our industry solutions, developed from deep engineering and IT expertise, are stringently aligned to ISO 14064, 14067 and 14068 standards and confidently employed by global corporations as an integral part of their transition towards net-zero outcomes.
 
Leveraging a trifecta of core strengths — profound engineering and IT expertise, strict adherence to ISO 14064-1 standards, and over a decade of industry experience — Evercomm emerges as the go-to ally for esteemed companies in Southeast Asia aiming for decarbonisation. 

Our NX-Series enterprise solution suite enables businesses to automate carbon footprint calculations down to the activity level. By integrating and standardising various types of sustainability data, including dynamic and static environmental data, Evercomm empowers businesses to set and track progress towards their sustainability goals and guides them in their journey. Winner in top-flight competitions like the COP28 UAE Techsprint and Microsoft’s Singapore Greentech Challenge 2023. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Evercomm has an Asia-Pacific network of offices to serve its customers including extensive operations in Taiwan and teams in Japan, Thailand, Malaysia and Myanmar with near-future ambitions to expand into the European marketplace.

Description:

Name: RepuTex Energy
Description:
Established in 1999, RepuTex is a leading provider of modelling services for the Australian electricity, renewable energy and emissions markets.

Our forecasts and analysis have been at the forefront of energy and climate thinking for over two decades, with a strong history of providing trusted, data-driven analysis for public and private sector customers in Australia and Asia.

We have worked with over 150 customers across Australia and Asia-Pacific – including government policymakers, regulators, high emitting companies and large energy users, project developers, investors and capital markets – working across the Electricity, Renewable Energy and Carbon and Climate Change service streams.

RepuTex has offices in Melbourne and Hong Kong, with a team of analysts with backgrounds in energy commodities, policy and regulation, meteorology, mathematics and engineering. The company is a winner of the China Light and Power-Australia China Business Award for energy and climate research across Asia-Pacific.

Name: Ventrx
Description:

Led by experts in science, engineering, and finance, Ventrx delivers bespoke analytics and strategies, empowering organizations to identify, mitigate risks and explore growth opportunities in an increasingly climate-impacted world.
